full_judgment: 12. Mr. SR Paul, the learned Advocate for the petitioner has argued at length that under section 56 of the Contract Act the tenancy between the plaintiff and the defendant was frustrated as the whole suit property was completely destroyed. In this connection he has relied on the case of Azizur Rahman & others vs. Abdus Sakur and others reported in 36 DLR (AD) 195. In that case several cases were referred to and discussed. While discussing whether the doctrine of frustration as embodied in section 56 of the Contract Act is applicable to leases of immovable property the Appellate Division discussed the case of Khitish Chandra Mondal VS. Shiba Rani Debi and others reported in AIR 1950 Cal. 441. In that case the plaintiff erected a thatched shed and which was rented out to a monthly tenant was burnt by fire.
